kicker: BUSINESS JUDGMENT · WORKFLOW DESIGN · HUMAN × AI
title: Designing How Organizations Work with AI.
positioning: Business judgment · Workflow design · Human × AI collaboration
subtitle: Business judgment, workflow design, and Human × AI collaboration—making AI a working part of the organization while people retain direction, authorization, and final judgment.
servicesTitle: WHAT I HELP ORGANIZATIONS MOVE FORWARD
services: Global Business Development — do more than filter a list; start with supplier reality and actively find market problems, buyer or channel types, and product entries worth testing.
Important Decisions & Workflows — turn a cross-functional problem that cannot be committed by instinct into a working system the team can move forward together.
Business Economics / Accounting-aware Judgment — use profit, cash, spending, evidence, and timing to frame material decisions; tax and legal conclusions remain with the appropriate professional.

deliverables.title: A clearer decision question
deliverables.body: Objective, constraints, known facts, and UNKNOWNs placed on one working surface.

deliverables.title: A working system the team can continue to use
deliverables.body: Research, comparison, handoff, and review translated into a repeatable workflow and brief.

deliverables.title: A traceable next move
deliverables.body: Evidence to obtain, questions to ask, rerun conditions, and the decision that still belongs to a person.

leverageTitle: AI-NATIVE EXECUTION · AI IS LEVERAGE, NOT THE IDENTITY
leverage: AI expands research, comparison, evidence organization, contradiction checks, and prototyping. A human sets the objective and boundary; evidence decides what deserves to move forward.
works: Commercial Decision Desk — turns net contribution, payment exposure, contradictions, and UNKNOWNs into one pre-commitment decision surface; synthetic cases, no customer-outcome claim.

Global Business Development / AI-Native Market Entry — start with supplier capability and market tension, then find buyer or channel paths worth verifying; UNKNOWN stays visible and relevance never becomes buyer evidence.
Trade Profit Navigator — puts margin, cash exposure, and testable profit levers on one surface; synthetic prototype, with no adoption, ROI, or customer-outcome claim.
Business Spending Insight — helps an owner clarify cash, timing, evidence, and CPA questions before professional review; synthetic cases, human validation pending.
process: Bring one stuck decision, workflow, or client situation. Make the decision, evidence, and human authority clear—then decide where AI should explore, organize, compare, or build.
